title: Confidential Western Australian government report warns gas exports risk slowing Asia’s move to clean energy
summary: Report by consultants Deloitte undermines Labor’s public claims that Western Australia’s gas exports help reduce emissions overseas Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Exports of Australian gas carry “substantial risks” of slowing the move to cleaner energy in Asian countries, according to a confidential report for the Western Australian government that undermines the government’s own narrative that the industry helps cut global emissions. The warning in the 2024 report by consultants Deloitte challenges the claim made by the Western Australian premier, Roger Cook, in 2023 that his state’s increased greenhouse pollution, largely driven by the vast amount of gas burnt to liquefy gas for export, is justified because it is good for the climate and displaces coal power in Asia. title: Resident doctors’ strike to go ahead after Wes Streeting’s last-ditch offer is rejected
summary: Resident doctors in England will strike for five days next week after saying the health secretary’s latest offer was too limited Wes Streeting has failed in an attempt to end the long-running resident doctors’ dispute with a new offer to them, which means their five-day strike next week is set to go ahead. The health secretary tabled a new offer to resident – formerly junior – doctors in England on Wednesday in a move intended to avoid that walkout – their 13th. Continue reading...

title: Floppy disks get a second life at Cambridge University Library
summary: A new program at the University of Cambridge library in the UK is asking people to bring in their floppy disks so that any digital artifacts on them can be extracted. Among rediscovered files are documents once belonging to Stephen Hawking, says technical analyst Leontien Talboom.
